name: aipm-unit-economics
description: Builds an AI Unit Economics Model with cost per call, per task and per successful outcome (retries and context included), a heavy-user scenario, caching and batch levers and a comparison with the current way of doing the task. Use for "run aipm-unit-economics", "cost per task", "cost per successful outcome", "what does each AI answer cost us", "finance wants to stop the feature", "token cost model", "heavy users are eating the margin", "is the AI cheaper than a person", part of the Claude for AI Product Managers Pack by 90n.
